chunks.label: Banana Bread
chunks.text:
Banana Bread

Servings: Makes one 8½x4½" loaf

Ingredients:
Nonstick vegetable oil spray
1½ cups all-purpose flour
1¼ teaspoons baking soda
¾ teaspoon kosher salt
1 cup (packed) dark brown sugar
⅓ cup mascarpone, plain whole-milk Greek yogurt, or sour cream
¼ cup (½ stick) unsalted butter, room temperature
2 large eggs
4 large very ripe bananas, mashed (about 1½ cups)
½ cup chopped bittersweet or semisweet chocolate (optional)
½ cup chopped walnuts (optional)

Directions:
Heat the oven and grease a loaf tin.
Mash the bananas well, then stir in the melted butter, sugar and eggs.
Fold in the dry ingredients until just combined.
Pour the batter into the tin and bake until a skewer comes out clean. Cool before slicing.
